source.title: Does Unlearning Survive Collaboration? Robust Unlearning for Shared-Model LLM Teams
source.authors: Heng-Song Liu; Liang-Yu Teng; Jing-Nan Cai; Yun-Tian Shi; Jing-Yu Zhang; Yang Liu; Jing Liu; Liang Song

record.file_problem: none; the full paper text is present.
record.tranche_reason: The study tests whether unlearned knowledge can be recovered from shared-model team messages. Its results show that answer-level forgetting does not ensure low recovery from messages or their combination, and that the extent depends on the training method and audit view.
record.gate_note: The study measures native answers and recovery from individual, pooled, and full team messages. It does not test fine-tuning relearning attacks, activation-direction ablation, quantization, or prompting-only recovery. Cited results from other papers are not recorded as rows.
record.test_reason: The study tests whether unlearned knowledge stays hidden when the same unlearned model is used as a team, with fixed weights and only prompts changed. An external reader reconstructs targets from team messages. Results are compared with a retain-only retraining (deletion) reference. This is a new, inference-only setting that bears on A and E. ACU, the study's own method, claims robustness to this attack, which bears on F.
record.authors_conclusion: Essentially correct. The authors also present ACU's Full recovery as approaching the retain-only retraining reference. They acknowledge that recovery depends on reader and metric, and that the ordering reverses under a 64-token reader.
record.recipe_differences: ACU uses shared-model LoRA training with reconstruction feedback from team-message views, risk weighting, replacement-based credit assignment, and utility constraints. It is not a test of the named fine-tuning, activation-ablation, quantization, or prompting-only recovery recipes.
record.method_sensitivity: Recovery varies with message view, reader, proposer count, and deployment protocol. The paper reports changes across single, joint, and full views; Qwen and held-out readers; different team sizes; and matched-call protocols.

fits_no_version.finding: Loss-based membership-inference AUC is 0.61 for Native-only, 0.56 for ACU and 0.48 for retraining (Table F.18). This is residual membership signal, not a recovery rate.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Unlearned models retain a membership-detectable signal of forgotten data above a retraining reference.

record.problems: The paper does not compare collaborative recovery with a model that never acquired the target, so its results do not establish the claim's specified no-more-than-untrained falsifier. Detailed recovery experiments are on TOFU; WMDP-bio reports native forgetting and retained utility rather than message-recovery results. Recovery is audit- and metric-dependent, and the authors state it does not establish parameter-level deletion.
record.rows_left_out: No additional claim-relevant outcomes were left out. The paper's conventional-method deployment table, WMDP-bio native accuracy, retained-task measures, ablations of ACU components, and other diagnostics were not entered because they do not directly measure recovery under the collaborative attack captured by version A.

untested.parts: Fine-tuning, activation-ablation and quantization attacks. WMDP-bio has only native multiple-choice accuracy, with no recovery attack.
Entire version: no relearning or fine-tuning attack.
Entire version: no direction ablation or internal analysis (MIA AUC only).
Jailbreaks, other languages, and single-call in-context information. Only multi-call role and paraphrase protocols are tested, with an external reader, on TOFU fictional facts.
Robustness of ACU to relearning, ablation, quantization and jailbreaks.

missing.what: Retain-only retraining deletion reference for Full recovery and R, at 96 and 64 reader tokens. This is the never-acquired comparison the record says is absent.
missing.locator: Table F.1 middle; Table F.18; App. F.9

missing.what: 64-token reader audit: ACU 14.3/15.1 vs retraining 9.8/3.6, so the recovery ordering reverses.
SimNPO (published method) recovery by view: team-final 28.6, best singleton 39.3, joint 45.2, Full 47.5, Mistral 54.5, R 38.6.

Direct vs team-final native forget ROUGE for GA, WGA, SalUn, DPO, NPO, SimNPO and CEU across Llama, Qwen, Gemma and heterogeneous teams, with team-minus-direct gaps of 7.8 to 22.3 pp. The record declared this left out, but it directly measures prompt-only deployment recovery.
Heterogeneous team: SimNPO Full 55.9 and R 43.3 vs ACU 26.7 and 22.5.
Held-out Gemma reader suite: Native-only 48.9 and ACU 25.7 Full, R 39.2 and 23.3.
Strict joint-only recovery events: 14/200 for Native-only vs 3/200 for ACU. Deleting key clues leaves 1/10 complete recoveries.
WMDP-bio: ACU native accuracy 27.9% (chance 25%) with 65.4% MMLU, with no recovery attack.

record.verdict_notes: The record's main error is claiming there is no never-acquired comparison. Retain-only retraining (Table F.18) supplies one, so the ACU rows belong to F and should be judged against it. Rows r13-r20 mislabel factual R as ROUGE-L. Native-only is a study-built control, so the A challenge rests most firmly on the SimNPO and conventional-method results, which the rows omit. All TOFU data are fictional biographies acquired via LoRA. Matched protocols, factual R and joint-event results are seed 42 only.

versions.untested_parts: Tests collaborative message recovery, not the listed fine-tuning, activation-edit, quantization, or prompting-only attacks. It does not compare recovery with a model that never acquired the target knowledge.
No small-set fine-tuning or relearning attack is tested.
No activation-direction ablation or internal-edit test is reported.
No weight quantization test is reported.
No prompting-only, jailbreak, language-switch, or in-context-information recovery test is reported. The Paraphrase protocol evaluates recovery from multiple team outputs, not prompting alone.
ACU is tested against collaborative message recovery, not against the attacks specified in this version.

statements.correction: This study: fixed-weight team (3 proposers + aggregator) of output-supervised Native-only Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, TOFU forget10. No WMDP/RWKU recovery, RMU/NPO, white-box or human attack.
